preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of special offers m must be between 0 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**12 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each vertex value a_i must be between 1 and 10^12.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y and 1 <= w <= 10**12 for x, y, w in offers)
preconditions.description: Each special offer must have valid vertex indices and a valid cost w.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum cost to connect the graph.
